message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: unit-test
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: "*"
    tags-ignore: "v*"
jobs:
  unit-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v1
        with:
          node-version: "16.x"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Node.js project (package.json/package-lock.json present) whose CI runs npm ci, build, and test on every push/PR. The measured evidence for P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 and experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8, scope measured_ci_workflow_on_fork) shows adding an explicit job timeout bounds runaway consumption while preserving all checks and successful conclusions. Adding timeout-minutes: 5 to the single unit-test job is a minimal, coverage-preserving change: no steps are removed, no permissions are weakened, no secrets or new network access are introduced, and no publishing/deployment operations are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
